title: Kinetic Game Feel, Stealth Envelopes & Actor AI
core_competencies: Responsive locomotion: instant input acknowledgment, coyote time, and turn-acceleration curves.
Sensory stealth envelopes: calculating visibility from scene light sources rather than binary zone triggers.
StateTree AI architectures: NPC behaviors driven by priority tasks (Flee Danger > Investigate Disturbance > Work Routine > Idle).
Physicalized interaction radii: clear affordances and raycast prioritization when players approach interactive objects.
anti_patterns: Locking player movement during camera interpolations.
Binary line-of-sight checks that ignore lighting conditions and obstacles.
Unforgiving interaction angles that frustrate players.
